profile.name: Rafely Chandra Rizkilillah
profile.subtitle: Specializing in Go backends, robust money-flow orchestration, and mission-critical financial systems.
retroNarrative: As a software engineer, especially in backend development, with over 7 years of deep specialization in payment and financial infrastructure, I focus on one core mission: building resilient money-movement systems that scale reliably and never drop a single transaction.

I architect central money-flow orchestration, build end-to-end QRIS acquiring and issuing systems, and integrate multi-vendor rails for remittance and virtual accounts using Go microservices, Kafka event pipelines, and finely tuned databases.

From resolving high-stakes Sev-0 production incidents to leading zero-downtime core banking migrations, I approach backend engineering with rigorous discipline, proactive reliability, and a focus on long-term scalability.

description: Architected and maintained the central Single API payment layer, orchestrating cash-in, cash-out, QRIS, remittance, and e-wallet transactions with strict state validations.
Led the end-to-end development of QRIS acquiring and issuing systems integrated with Artajasa/ASPI, delivering static/dynamic QR APIs, merchant credits, refund flows, and resilient retry logic.
Integrated multi-provider remittance and Virtual Account rails (BRI, Midtrans, FLIP) with real-time callback orchestration and automated settlement status reconciliations.
Engineered reliable webhook integration pipelines to process real-time transaction notifications from third-party banking vendors with signature verification and retry mechanisms.
Deployed an observability stack using Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch for real-time payment metrics, latency tracing, and proactive alerting.
Safeguarded ledger integrity during peak traffic by resolving critical Sev-0 concurrency issues, eliminating duplicate wallet debits and idempotency race conditions.

experiences.role: Software Developer Engineer Sr. Analyst (Wealth Team)
description: Led a team of 4 engineers delivering e-wallet funding, cash-out, and investment order services for hundreds of thousands of active retail investors.
Integrated payment aggregators (Xendit, Midtrans) for seamless wallet funding, enabling rapid onboarding of new digital payment channels.
Implemented Kafka-driven event pipelines for asynchronous loan order settlement, decoupling upstream dependencies and eliminating request timeout bottlenecks.
Designed priority installment repayment workflows, ensuring mathematically precise repayment allocations and accurate investor ledger balances.
Rebuilt core disbursement and repayment microservices from the ground up, significantly improving transaction reliability across micro-loan products.
Led core banking migration to third-party vendor FDS, coordinating cross-team alignment and ensuring a zero-downtime cutover for all live company transactions.
Automated loan insurance claim triggers for non-performing loans with 4+ consecutive missed installments, actively protecting investor capital without manual operational overhead.
Developed and maintained operational MIS dashboards tracking loan health, investor portfolios, and installment lifecycles to support data-driven risk decisions.
Designed and implemented high-performance REST APIs for Tunaiku's customer-facing Help Center and FAQ platform using Go and PostgreSQL.
Built FAQ helpfulness tracking metrics and feedback telemetry, enabling Customer Service teams to measure article resolution rates and discover unresolved user pain points.
Collaborated with Customer Experience teams to streamline self-service workflows, directly reducing repetitive support ticket volume.

achievements: Graduated with a Bachelor of Computer Science, focusing on distributed computing, relational database systems, and concurrent algorithms.

Undergraduate Thesis: "Penerapan Penjadwalan Program Kerja Indonesian Future Leaders Chapter Malang Menggunakan Algoritme Genetika", researching and applying Genetic Algorithms (GA) for combinatorial schedule optimization.

Google AI Competition Certification: #JuaraVibeCoding, 2026, awarded for developing and deploying two AI-powered web applications on Google Cloud Run using Gemini AI Studio: 'Make It 24' (math puzzle game) and 'Indonesian E-Voting Simulation'.

dossiers.title: Sev-0 Ledger Race Condition Mitigation Protocol
dossiers.summary: Full post-mortem analysis and atomic distributed locking architecture on Redis + PostgreSQL advisory locks to eliminate duplicate wallet settlement transactions under 10k RPS burst loads.
details: Implemented idempotent transaction idempotency keys using sha256 hashes of incoming request payloads combined with client token signatures.
Introduced a 2-phase commit state machine validation ensuring ledger entries and bank adapter dispatches can never desynchronize during transient network timeouts.
Stress tested with k6 distributed agents generating 12,000 synthetic payment hits across 4 worker nodes with 0 ledger discrepancies.

dossiers.title: Next-Gen QRIS Acquiring Adapter Architecture
dossiers.summary: Internal routing topology for multi-acquirer switching with automated fallback, real-time fee calculations, and sub-millisecond reverse-Luhn verification.
details: Decoupled third-party switching latency from consumer payment flows using buffered event streaming via Kafka.
Configured circuit-breakers with 300ms SLA cutoff to instantly reroute failed QRIS transaction requests to secondary banking rails.
Integrated automated reconciliation daemon running hourly delta validations.

dossiers.title: Confidential Career Milestones & Technical Aspirations
dossiers.summary: Personal engineering roadmap focusing on high-availability distributed financial systems, AI-accelerated developer tooling, and modern distributed storage runtimes.
details: Targeting Staff / Principal level distributed architecture roles in Southeast Asian & global fintech ecosystems.
Deep research into Raft consensus algorithms, custom Go runtime profiling, and zero-knowledge ledger verification.
Open to strategic advisory and architect consulting on high-scale Go systems.
